text:
kevin: FYI saw a config apply during the canary that coincided with a spike in 503s. wondering how we should classify config applies so oncall only gets meaningful pages. tagging @julia @anya

julia: can you drop the exact diff and which routing/quota was changed? console or infra change?

kevin: console-initiated. diff excerpt:
```
- route_quota: 10000
+ route_quota: 20000
- enable_new_routing: false
+ enable_new_routing: true
```
about ~6% of requests to the canary cohort returned 503 during rollout window.

anya: sounds like we want to distinguish "apply succeeded but runtime impact" vs "apply failed to persist". Not all applies should page.

matt: idea: add a tiny classification contract to the config apply call: `severity` (info|warn|page) and `impact_hint` (short string). server runs heuristics and returns recommended severity; UI can show and owner can override. telemetry emits structured events for applies.

kevin: who should author the initial `severity`? owner in the manifest or server heuristic?

julia: prefer server-recommended default + owner override with a required override_reason. server heuristics use delta in 5xx, percent of tenants affected, and exposure window.

ops-bot: deploy:config-apply for rollout `rollout-xyz789` reported 87 invocations, 6% error rate, auto-rollback to snapshot `s-2024-02-18`.

anya: good bot output. let's make thresholds explicit in the API: `page_if_error_rate_above`, `page_on_slo_breach` boolean, and `exposure_window_seconds`. defaults sensible but visible in console.

matt: also record `computed_by` and `computed_at` audit fields so oncall can see why server suggested a severity. console should surface the metric that tripped the heuristic.

kevin: action plan: 1) extend apply API response with `recommended_severity` and `impact_hint`, 2) emit `config.apply.success` / `config.apply.failure` telemetry with numeric `tenant_count`, `error_rate`, and `exposure_window_seconds`, 3) draft heuristics PR and RFC. I'll own RFC.

julia: please include audit fields `set_by`, `computed_by`, `override_reason` and a read-only history view for oncall.

kevin: creating RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/config-apply-alerting-2026 . will post PR + console mocks when ready.

matt: :thumbsup:

anya: thanks, this should cut down noisy pages. :dizzy:
